tex_content.html:
If $\M $ is a Ricci flow with surgery, with normalized initial condition at time zero, then for all $t \ge 0$, $R(x,t) \: \ge \: - \: \frac{3}{2} \: \frac{1}{t+\frac14}$.

Proof

\sketch Use the reduced-length and reduced-volume identities, the maximum principle, and the cited surgery estimates; the resulting barriers give the stated bound.

□

Lemma
[existence for kappa solutions]
